title: Ashfall Showcase Opening
briefing: Use the first Ashfall session to touch the ECHO stack in a readable order while keeping the profile isolated from generic templates.

objectives.label: Open Terminal
objectives.detail: Read the Ashfall dashboard and confirm the next-step summary.

objectives.label: Read the first Index archive
objectives.detail: Open the Showcase Flow and Profile Isolation entries.

objectives.label: Scan pod wreckage with Lens
objectives.detail: Use the Ashfall showcase scan row to reveal the first marker and mission hint.

objectives.label: Track the first HoloMap marker
objectives.detail: Pin the field objective before leaving the pod route.

objectives.label: React to the first WeatherCore warning
objectives.detail: Use the toxic-front warning as a tutorial beat rather than a punishment spike.

objectives.label: Recover a relic field note
objectives.detail: Bridge RelicTech, Index, Lens, and SoundCore with a small discovery.

objectives.label: Repair the pod power spine
objectives.detail: Use the PowerGrid repair note before larger factory systems appear.

objectives.label: Install a first Armory upgrade
objectives.detail: Introduce gear readiness before faction/story pressure rises.
